title: LiDAR-SHIELD: A Fully Dockerized Adversarial Robustness Assessment Framework for LiDAR-Based 3D Perception Models
abstract: arXiv:2610.39848v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: LiDAR-based 3D perception underpins autonomous driving and robotics, yet deploying these models safely requires stress-testing them against adversarial inputs before real-world use. Although state-of-the-art adversarial attacks exist, their implementations are often fragmented across individual repositories, each tied to a specific architecture or task and requiring manual environment reconstruction and model-specific integration code. We present LIDARSHIELD, a unified and fully Dockerized framework that reverses this workflow: rather than installing the target model inside the toolkit, LIDARSHIELD exposes any model through three lightweight HTTP endpoints, namely /info, /forward, and /gradient As a result, connecting a new model or dataset requires only a single loader function or adapter. translated_title: LiDAR-SHIELD：一个全容器化的面向激光雷达三维感知模型的对抗鲁棒性评估框架
translated_abstract: 基于激光雷达的三维感知技术是自动驾驶和机器人技术的基础，然而要安全地部署这些模型，需要在实际应用之前针对对抗性输入对其进行压力测试。尽管目前已有最先进的对抗攻击方法，但它们的实现往往分散在各个独立的代码仓库中，每个仓库都绑定特定的架构或任务，需要手动重建环境并编写模型特定的集成代码。我们提出了LIDARSHIELD，这是一个统一且完全容器化（Dockerized）的框架，它颠覆了传统的工作流程：LIDARSHIELD不是将目标模型安装到工具包内部，而是通过三个轻量级的HTTP端点来暴露任何模型，即 /info、/forward 和 /gradient。因此，接入新的模型或数据集只需编写一个加载函数或适配器即可。该框架通过统一的引擎-服务协议同时支持三维语义分割和三维目标检测，并集成了一个任务感知的…
tldr: 提出了LIDAR-SHIELD，一个完全Docker化的统一对抗鲁棒性评估框架，通过轻量级HTTP端点协议将目标模型与攻击工具解耦，使接入新模型只需一个加载函数，并同时支持三维语义分割和目标检测任务。
en_tdlr: LiDAR-SHIELD is a fully Dockerized unified framework for adversarial robustness assessment that decouples attack tools from target models via lightweight HTTP endpoints, enabling model integration with a single loader function while supporting both 3D semantic segmentation and object detection.
